reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the redline is identical to the original paragraphs with no counterparty comment — consistent with the expectation that compliant findings carry no edits.

Cited text supports the preferred position: Section 5.1.3(a) grants an exclusive licence to Exploit, Section 5.3 permits sublicensing through multiple tiers to Affiliates and other Persons (covering contractors), Section 12.1.2 makes the grants fully-paid and irrevocable on expiry, and Section 13.4.1 permits assignment to Affiliates or an M&A successor and binds Harpoon's successors.

No at-will revocation in Harpoon's favour is present in the cited grant/termination architecture; both deterministic checks (affiliate coverage, no at-will revocation) pass and the rationale accurately reflects the quoted language.
